findings.claim: The CI change removes compile coverage for the combined embedded SurrealKV plus remote feature set, so regressions in that supported feature combination can ship undetected.
findings.evidence: The prior steps ran `cargo check -p compass-cli --features surreal-surrealkv,surreal-remote --locked` under names explicitly covering combined embedded and standalone surfaces; both hunks replace that with `cargo check -p compass-cli --features surreal-remote --locked` only.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep a separate `cargo check` for `--features surreal-surrealkv,surreal-remote` if the combined feature set remains supported, and add the remote-only check as an additional release-surface gate rather than replacing it.
